excerpt: Truthmaker theory is committed to a proposition of the form <e exists> being made true by e; similarly, if proposition B is true and states that B is true, the fact that B is true is grounded in itself.
overview: The reflexivity evidence is not an empirical observation but a pair of formal constructions. It establishes that truthmaking and alethic-fact grounding can relate something to itself, which directly violates the irreflexivity required for strict orderhood.
title: Self-Truthmaker Argument
